breakdown.description: The prompt substitutes the bending second moment I for the polar moment J in torsion formulas, even though solid circular shaft torsion is governed by J = π d^4/32.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly ignores the incorrect instruction to use I = π d^4/64 in torsion relations and correctly uses J = π d^4/32 for both the shear stress and angle of twist calculations, matching the ground truth prompt.
